title: UMPI Phase 2B — licensing closure rights matrix
status: internal research; establishes no legal right; no source approved; no observation collected

product_under_test.published_value: the selected source close, unchanged, in USD per chip

response.binding_note: sales guidance from a named salesperson; no licence document, term sheet or draft agreement received

sources.conversation_state: closed by Urdais on budget grounds 2026-09-15; vendor invited a future approach 2026-09-17; not a refusal

g1_access.clause: We only provide Excel files, and no other APIs are currently available.
g1_access.notes: paid membership delivers Excel files; no machine interface exists

g2_storage.evidence: terms silent; vendor did not answer
g2_storage.notes: retaining parsed observations as a canonical database is not addressed in any text read

g3_calculation.clause: YOU MAY NOT REPRODUCE, MODIFY, CREATE DERIVATIVE WORKS FROM, DISPLAY, PERFORM, PUBLISH, DISTRIBUTE, DISSEMINATE, BROADCAST OR CIRCULATE TO ANY THIRD PARTY
g3_calculation.notes: derivative-works bar reaches a calculated output; vendor's re-analysis sentence implies internal calculation is not the objection

g4_derived_publication.clause: if the data is to be published only after a complete re-analysis, we can open a separate discussion regarding the license
g4_derived_publication.notes: a discussion, not a grant; conditioned on re-analysis that UMPI V1 does not perform

g5_post_termination_retention.evidence: no termination-data clause in ToU; asked and not answered
g5_post_termination_retention.notes: silence is not permission; Phase 2A makes this a launch gate

raw_price_republication.clause: DISPLAY... PUBLISH... CIRCULATE TO ANY THIRD PARTY / We do not permit the commercial use of our data.
raw_price_republication.notes: THE BLOCKING RIGHT. UMPI V1 publishes the close unchanged, which is outside the complete-re-analysis opening

commercial_use.clause: We do not permit the commercial use of our data.
commercial_use.notes: unqualified as written under standard membership

attribution.clause: USERS ARE REQUIRED TO INCLUDE A NOTICE INDICATING THAT THE WEBSITE IS THE SOURCE OF THE MATERIAL
attribution.notes: form exists but applies only once a use is authorized; wording and placement for a price surface unconfirmed

automation_rate_limits.evidence: no automation clause in ToU; vendor did not answer
automation_rate_limits.notes: practical question is whether scheduled parsing of a licensed Excel file is permitted

speculative_use_clause.text: YOU ARE PROHIBITED FROM USING, REFERENCING, INCORPORATING, OR RELYING UPON ANY PRICES, DATA, FORECASTS, RESEARCH, OR OTHER CONTENT PROVIDED THROUGH THE WEBSITE IN CONNECTION WITH ANY BETTING, WAGERING, PREDICTION MARKET, OR OTHER SPECULATIVE ACTIVITY
speculative_use_clause.assessment: binds the user of the website; an informational benchmark is not on its face within it; 'or other speculative activity' is undefined
speculative_use_clause.action: request explicit written carve-out confirmation; do not conclude either way from the text
